summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing the circular for its annual general meeting (AGM). The circular includes proposals for general mandates to issue and repurchase shares, re-election of retiring directors, re-appointment of auditor, and amendments to articles of association. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine AGM circular with standard governance items.
